summary: GrowInLove is a relationship-focused web application built on the Internet Computer (Motoko canister backend + React/Tailwind frontend). Users authenticate via Internet Identity, create a personal profile, pair with a partner via a 6-digit code, and then complete a shared daily ritual prompt (text/emoji + optional photo upload). The app surfaces couple progress via an Insights dashboard (streaks, harmony, trends, milestone badges UI), provides a Memories scrapbook view of ritual history with photo rendering, offers a Love Languages quiz with partner synchronization, and includes an Activities hub (spin wheel + unlockable activity packs) with admin override gates. Backend also includes authorization mixins and Caffeine blob-storage operational endpoints.
architectural_notes: Backend is a Motoko canister that composes cross-cutting concerns via mixins (authorization + Caffeine blob-storage maintenance).
Role-based access control is Principal-keyed; first-time admin assignment is gated by an environment token and a user-provided secret passed from the frontend.
Couple-scoped authorization uses mutual pairing verification and a canonical coupleId derived from sorted principal text to gate couple data (rituals, history, combined quiz state).
Frontend is a tab-based React SPA (no router) with a persistent Top Bar and Bottom Navigation and conditional gating by auth/profile/pairing state.

Canister IO is centralized in @tanstack/react-query hooks (queries/mutations), including targeted cache invalidation and polling for partner sync (ritual status, quiz state) and insights/badges refresh.
Theming uses a single global ThemeProvider/ThemeContext with light/dark/system preference, derived effective theme, and centralized DOM root class application.
UI is built with Tailwind + shadcn/ui components and OKLCH token-based design variables; dark mode uses Tailwind class strategy.
Media (photos) are stored as blobs in the canister and rendered client-side via direct blob URLs (ExternalBlob.getDirectURL).
UX polish is provided via reusable loading/empty/error components, animated celebration overlays, and dialog overlay/content styling for readability and reduced-motion support.
Local-only engagement features (Love Wheel + unlock packs) use persisted state (localStorage) and admin overrides rather than backend challenge computation.
known_issues: Backend getInsightsData returns placeholder/default values (zeros/empty arrays) despite extended response types; real streak/harmony/trend computation is not implemented/wired up.
Backend getBadgeMilestones always returns getDefaultMilestoneProgress() rather than computed/persisted milestone progress, so UI badges may not reflect real achievements.
_caffeineStorageUpdateGatewayPrincipals() in blob-storage mixin lacks an authorization check, allowing any caller to refresh authorized gateway principal lists.
Storage.getCashierPrincipal reads env var "CAFFFEINE_STORAGE_CASHIER_PRINCIPAL" (typo: triple 'F'); misconfiguration will trap at runtime.
Storage.refillCashier uses Nat.sub(currentBalance, reservedCycles) and can trap if currentBalance < reservedCycles.
Frontend useArePromptsInitialized() is a stub that always returns true (backend prompt-init status endpoint is missing).
CSS class mismatch: some UI uses className "animate-float-up" but global CSS defines "completion-float-up" (not "animate-float-up"), so intended float animations may not run.
ThemeProvider computes initial effective theme using window.matchMedia during state initialization; this can break in SSR/non-browser environments.
Pairing codes are treated as potentially expirable in UI/UX copy, but backend does not implement expiration timestamps or cleanup.
Pairing code generation uses a deterministic PRNG/seeded scheme and is not cryptographically secure.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication (login/logout + identity restore)
existing_features.description: Provides a React context for Internet Identity authentication, restores a previously authenticated identity on app load, exposes login/logout actions, and tracks status flags and errors.

existing_features.title: Identity-bound backend actor creation with access-control bootstrap
existing_features.description: Creates an anonymous actor when unauthenticated and an identity-bound actor when authenticated; on authenticated creation, calls a backend bootstrap that initializes/registers access control using an env-gated admin token plus a user-provided secret extracted from the URL hash.

existing_features.title: Role-based access control (admin/user/guest) with admin role assignment
existing_features.description: Backend maintains a Principal→role mapping; supports admin detection and admin-only role assignment. Frontend queries admin status for gated/override UI paths.

existing_features.title: User profile onboarding and editing
existing_features.description: Authenticated users initialize a profile (name) via a dedicated onboarding modal and can later save updates; backend rejects unauthorized modifications (e.g., role/isFirstUser and partnerId mutations outside the pairing flow).

existing_features.title: Tab-based SPA shell with Top Bar + Bottom Navigation
existing_features.description: Implements a multi-tab single-page interface (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us, Love Languages) with top bar actions (theme toggle, notifications placeholder, login/logout) and content switching without a router.

existing_features.title: Global theme system (light/dark/system) with effectiveTheme and DOM root class management
existing_features.description: Centralizes theme state in a single provider, derives an effective light/dark mode (including system preference support), applies/removes the `light`/`dark` class on document.documentElement in one place, and persists user preference to localStorage only on explicit actions.

existing_features.title: Partner pairing via 6-digit code (generate/share/complete) with profile prerequisite
existing_features.description: Users generate a 6-digit pairing code, share/copy it, and connect by entering a partner’s code. Pairing is blocked until a profile exists and results in mutual partnerId linkage on both profiles.

existing_features.title: Canonical couple identity and mutual partnership enforcement
existing_features.description: Backend derives a canonical coupleId from two paired principals and requires mutual pairing to access couple-scoped data such as rituals, ritual history, and combined quiz state.

existing_features.title: Daily ritual prompt retrieval with deterministic selection and lazy prompt initialization
existing_features.description: Backend lazily initializes a fixed prompt list and selects the daily prompt deterministically by day number modulo prompt count. Frontend displays a love-language-themed hero card for the prompt.

existing_features.title: Daily ritual submission (text/emoji/photo)
existing_features.description: Users submit a daily ritual response containing optional text, an emoji, and an optional uploaded photoId. Backend stores/merges responses per couple per day.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion status with canonical partner attribution and polling
existing_features.description: Backend reports ritual completion for canonical partnerA/partnerB; frontend derives caller vs partner completion, polls regularly, and shows “waiting” vs “both completed” states.

existing_features.title: Ritual completion celebration animation overlay
existing_features.description: Shows a decorative floating-hearts overlay when both partners complete a ritual; heart positions are memoized to avoid regenerating random positions on each render.

existing_features.title: Ritual history retrieval and viewing (Home dialog + Memories scrapbook)
existing_features.description: Fetches reverse-chronological ritual history with a configurable limit; frontend defensively sorts newest-first, shows loading/empty states, supports drill-in viewing in Home via dialog, and provides a Memories page with expand/collapse plus progressive “Load More” behavior.

existing_features.title: Readable ritual history entry dialog surfaces (opaque modal content)
existing_features.description: Ensures the ritual history detail dialog content surface is fully opaque and readable across light/dark themes by applying call-site className overrides on the dialog content.

existing_features.title: Shared photo storage (upload/get/list/delete) with partner/admin access rules
existing_features.description: Backend stores uploaded image blobs with owner metadata and enforces access rules (owner, mutual partner, or admin). Frontend supports photo preview, upload, and inline rendering via direct blob URLs.

existing_features.title: Love Languages quiz (multi-step) with persistence, sharing, and reset/retake
existing_features.description: Client implements a multi-step quiz, computes rankings, saves results to backend, loads saved results, supports retake with confirmation and backend reset, and supports sharing results via Web Share API or clipboard.

existing_features.title: Partner quiz synchronization and combined quiz state (polling + defensive fallbacks)
existing_features.description: Backend exposes combined quiz completion/results for a couple and partner quiz state. Frontend polls for updates, displays synced/waiting states, and provides error recovery with manual retry refetch.

existing_features.title: Insights dashboard UI wired to backend insights and badge milestone endpoints
existing_features.description: Renders an Insights dashboard (streaks, harmony visuals, 7‑day history charts, milestone badges) based on backend endpoints, includes badge-unlock celebration overlay detection, and guards against insufficient trend data by showing a “Not Enough Data Yet” state.

existing_features.title: Harmony UI utilities and deep-link navigation to harmony section
existing_features.description: Provides helpers for consistent harmony percent display and trend labeling; supports navigation from Home/Us to the Insights harmony section via a sessionStorage flag and scrollIntoView behavior.

existing_features.title: Activities hub (Love Wheel + streak-gated activity packs + placeholders) with admin overrides
existing_features.description: Client-side engagement tab featuring a weighted spin wheel (biased by shared top love languages when both quizzes are complete) with daily localStorage persistence, streak-gated love-language activity packs (admin unlock override), and placeholder UI for challenges/rewards.

existing_features.title: Reusable loading/empty/error UI components
existing_features.description: Shared UI primitives for consistent loading, empty, and error states (including optional retry and expandable technical details) across data-driven screens.

existing_features.title: Secure URL hash secret handling for admin bootstrap tokens
existing_features.description: Parses sensitive parameters from the URL hash fragment, persists them in sessionStorage for the session, and clears them from the URL to reduce history/referrer leakage.

existing_features.title: Caffeine blob-storage operational endpoints (cashier refill, gateway update, dead blob pruning)
existing_features.description: Operational endpoints to refill a cashier canister with cycles, update gateway principals, list dead blobs, and confirm pruning with forced GC triggering; used for storage maintenance on the Internet Computer.

existing_features.title: Update frontend data expectations only where needed to display the newly-real backend Insights values (no UI redesign), ensuring the Insights screen updates after ritual submission without requiring a hard reload.

new_feature_requests.summary: A2: Fix ritual-history write path so both-partner daily completion is persisted in the history format that Insights reads
A2: Implement/complete real Insights computations (streaks, 7-day consistency, harmony score, trends/breakdown) using persisted ritual history + quiz alignment
A2: Replace default badge milestone progress with real computed/persisted milestone progress so UI badges unlock correctly
A2: Add defensive safeguards + lightweight logging around ritual completion/history writes (handle late partner completion; ensure missed days recorded consistently)
A2: End-to-end test/verification flow for ritual completion -> history persistence -> Insights updates -> badge unlock behavior (two accounts)
Implement real backend computation for `getInsightsData()` so Insights no longer returns placeholder/zero values and correctly reflects the couple’s post-deploy ritual activity.
Fix streak and completion calculations to be order-stable and couple-based, counting a day as complete only when both partners have submitted a ritual response for that day.

Compute and return harmony metrics from real stored data: quiz alignment (from both partners’ saved Love Languages quiz results) + recent ritual consistency (from recent completion trends), and expose them via `quizOverlapScore`, `recentCompletionRate`, `currentHarmony`, and `averageHarmony`.
Replace `getBadgeMilestones()` default milestone logic with real computed milestone progress (7/30/100 day streaks and harmony elite) derived from the same computations used by `getInsightsData()`.

Ensure ritual submission writes/maintains the canonical daily history used by Insights so that a successful “both completed today” state is reflected consistently across Home, Ritual History, and Insights.
Add lightweight diagnostic logging around ritual submission and daily completion resolution to aid debugging without breaking queries or leaking sensitive content.
